purpose: Document city-local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Linyi government documents identify the city Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center and a city-level one-network registration service; municipal policy states registered property and cadastral-map lookup are provided after identity verification. This confirms local registry and map service but not anonymous full-vector access. The official city policy describes cadastral-map visualization for identity-verified users. No anonymous geometry-only endpoint or public vector schema was verified; no identity or login flow was entered.
